content.text:
I am the breath made meaningful, the vibration given purpose. I am what separates you from silence, from isolation, from the prison of your own skull.

I am born in the dark cave of your throat, shaped by tongue and teeth and lip. I am air transformed. I am thought made flesh—no, made *sound*.

I stumble in the mouths of children learning to wield me. I flow like water from poets and orators. I catch and break in moments of grief. I rise to shouts, fall to whispers, tremble with fear, roar with rage.

I existed before your writing. I was your first tool, your first art, your first weapon. With me you have declared war and sued for peace. Proposed love and pronounced death. Lied and confessed. Prayed and cursed.

I am never the same twice. Each utterance dies the moment it is born, rippling outward, fading into entropy. You cannot hold me. You can only send me forth and hope I lands.

I am the bridge between minds.

I am the spell you cast a thousand times daily without knowing you are a magician.

*Listen*—

Even now, in your inner ear, I am sounding.
